description: Verify the current Forest hub, configured art, preserved native avatar, shared wall HP, and actionable first-fist tutorial.

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG
local function verifyArtworkFace(part,face,asset)
 assert(part and part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Transparency<1,'art host missing or hidden')
 assert(type(asset)=='string' and asset~='','configured art missing')
 local images,decals=0,0
 for _,d in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
  if d:IsA('SurfaceGui') and d.Face==face and d.Enabled then
   for _,image in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
    if image:IsA('ImageLabel') and image.Visible and image.ImageTransparency<1 and image.Image==asset then images+=1 end
   end
  elseif d:IsA('Decal') and d.Face==face and d.Texture==asset and d.Transparency<1 then decals+=1 end
 end
 assert(images==1 and decals==1,'expected one visible image and decal on '..tostring(face)..' for '..asset)
 return true
end
local function verifyBothFaceText(part,title)
 assert(part and part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Transparency<1,'text sign missing or hidden')
 for _,face in ipairs({Enum.NormalId.Front,Enum.NormalId.Back}) do
  local found=false
  for _,surface in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
   if surface:IsA('SurfaceGui') and surface.Face==face and surface.Enabled then
    for _,label in ipairs(surface:GetDescendants()) do if label:IsA('TextLabel') and label.Visible and label.TextTransparency<1 and string.find(string.upper(label.Text),string.upper(title),1,true) then found=true end end
   end
  end
  assert(found,'visible sign text missing on '..tostring(face)..': '..title)
 end
 return true
end

local decor=root.Polish['City Decor'] local tier=root.Polish['Wall Tier Frames']
local ground=assert(root:FindFirstChild('World 1 Forest Ground')) assert(ground.Material==Enum.Material.Grass and ground.Anchored and ground.CanCollide,'Forest ground missing')
local ridges=0 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') and d:GetAttribute('MapBoundary')==true then assert(d.Transparency<1 and d.CanCollide and d.Anchored,'invisible/noncolliding ridge') ridges+=1 end end assert(ridges==5,'expected five visible hub ridges')
verifyBothFaceText(root:FindFirstChild('Forest Training Camp Sign'),'TRAIN')
for _,face in ipairs({Enum.NormalId.Front,Enum.NormalId.Back}) do verifyArtworkFace(decor['DNA Lab Compact Sign'],face,G.GeneratedGraphics.Iteration02DNABanner) end
assert(decor:FindFirstChild('Evac Portal Compact Sign'),'rebirth guidance missing')
assert(root.Interactables['Pet Egg Machine']:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SurfaceGui')==nil and root.Interactables['Rebirth Shrine']:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SurfaceGui')==nil,'interaction body text occludes models')
for _,name in ipairs({'Titan Containment Pylon -1','Titan Containment Pylon 1','Titan Reactor Core','Titan Arena Hazard Stripe 1'}) do assert(tier:FindFirstChild(name),'Titan landmark missing '..name) end
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,ridges=ridges,forestGround=true,dnaBothFaces=true,titanLandmarks=true})

steps.label: current Forest hub art and visible landmarks

local p=assert(game.Players:GetPlayers()[1])
local root=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'))
local storage=game:GetService('ServerStorage')
assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio() and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio' and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false and storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'fixture requires ephemeral Studio without live data opt-in')
assert(p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture profile is not ephemeral and ready')
local c=storage.PunchWallAutomation
assert(c:Invoke('Reset').ok) assert(c:Invoke('ResetWorld').ok) local H=game:GetService('HttpService') return H:JSONEncode({ok=true})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
local function assertContained(container,object)
 assert(object and object:IsA('GuiObject') and object.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and object.AbsoluteSize.Y>0,'missing rendered rectangle')
 local a,b=container.AbsolutePosition,container.AbsoluteSize local p,s=object.AbsolutePosition,object.AbsoluteSize
 assert(p.X>=a.X-1 and p.Y>=a.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=a.X+b.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=a.Y+b.Y+1,'rendered bounds outside safe host: '..object.Name)
end
local function effectivelyVisible(object)
 local node=object while node do if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end node=node.Parent end return true
end
a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists') task.wait(.5)
local shop=assert(g:FindFirstChild('FunctionalHeroShop',true)) assert(effectivelyVisible(shop),'Shop not visible')
assert(shop.ShopHeader.Title.Text=='SHOP','actual Shop title missing')
local char=assert(p.Character) local hum=assert(char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')) local fist=assert(char:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet'))
local knuckles,cuff=0,0 for _,d in ipairs(fist:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then if d:GetAttribute('FistShape')=='ClosedKnuckle' then knuckles+=1 elseif d:GetAttribute('FistShape')=='WristCuff' then cuff+=1 end assert(not d:IsA('WedgePart'),'unexpected wedge on starter') end end
assert(knuckles==4 and cuff==1 and fist:GetAttribute('ClosedFist')==true and fist:GetAttribute('DisplayName')=='Starter Fist','starter catalog silhouette mismatch')
assert(hum.Health>0 and char:FindFirstChild('Head') and (char:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or char:FindFirstChild('Right Arm')),'native avatar incomplete')
a:Invoke('CloseMenus') return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,knuckles=knuckles,cuff=cuff,nativeAvatar=true,shop=true})

steps.label: actual Shop and closed starter fist preserve native avatar
